posts.title: Airtel (AS9498) to take the lead on the RPKI RoV front
posts.description: Just back from Mumbai after APNIC 62 and Equinix’s India Peering Forum. On excellent news: Airtel has started sending emails to its customers about RPKI RoV (Route Origin Validation). As per the mail, Airtel will start RPKI RoV soon and has mentioned 22 Sep 2026 as the timeline when they will start rolling out RoV. This is excellent news on the routing security front, and kudos to Airtel (AS9498)
